title: Bring the strategic onto the cap table before you need them as a buyer, or as an acquirer.
play: Name the three strategics most likely to be both your largest customer and your eventual acquirer.
Offer one a small allocation in the next round, tied to a commercial agreement.
Move the pilot into co-development before anyone negotiates exclusivity.

timeline.label: Memorandum of understanding
timeline.event: Fincantieri and WSense sign a memorandum of understanding on strategic collaboration (21 Dec 2023).
timeline.verify_note: The spec cited src_wsense_round, which returned HTTP 403. The date is confirmed in the Fincantieri press release instead.

timeline.label: Strategic investor
timeline.event: Fincantieri formalises an investment in WSense through a convertible loan of €2.5M, with an option for a further €2.5M (15 Apr 2025).
timeline.verify_note: The spec framing (part of the €7.2M pre-Series B, alongside Rypples) could not be checked: the Seedtable page returned HTTP 403. Only what the Fincantieri release states is kept.

timeline.label: Co-development
timeline.verify_note: Not found in the src_wsense_acq snapshot (PortNews, 6 Jul 2026). Kept as illustrative until a source is found.

timeline.label: Majority stake
timeline.event: Fincantieri agrees to take a majority stake in WSense, initially 61.95% of the acquiring vehicle and up to 75% within 24 months, part of an initial spend of about €600m across four underwater deals (6 Jul 2026).

title: Write conversion terms into every pilot
play: Agree the metric that proves the pilot worked before it starts.
Write the price and volume of the first commercial contract into the pilot agreement.
Set a decision date with the buyer's budget holder.

title: Price the first plant on total cost of ownership, not capex
play: Model cost per unit of output over the asset life, including operations and replacement.
Show lenders the downside case next to the base case.
Let the buyer compare you with the incumbent on the same basis.

title: Hire operations leadership in-market before the second site
play: Name the market for site two before the search starts.
Hire the operations lead there, not at headquarters.
Give them a first-90-days scorecard tied to site two.
